title: Vibed this mini game as a break from my main project and now i’m hooked
author: lorean_victor
selftext: so I started working on a mobile game in my off time a few months back, and it’s going well but to take a break vibe coded this tiny game with Sol high in like an hour (iterating on difficulty mainly as I wanted it to feel difficult but fair) and now i‘m addicted! it’s a web game so you can check it out here (designed for touch input so maybe try on your phone): [https://vibed.city/e/019fc778-21ad-725c-b5c1-2efbb14ad253b](https://vibed.city/e/019fc778-21ad-725c-b5c1-2efbb14ad253)
